exclusion_reason: The PE32 runtime and browser matrix are unimplemented, so x86-64 architecture cannot yet be measured in context.
promotion_trigger: Promote when a prototype runs FIX-024 and an approved report covers address space, memory64, browser support, JIT, exception, performance, license, and migration cost.
expected_failing_assertion: No evidenced x86-64 browser architecture meets the memory and performance envelope.
active_gate_evidence: The initial compatibility contract explicitly excludes x86-64.
procedure: Prototype viable execution and memory option on the frozen browser profile.
Measure instruction, address, exception, memory, compile, startup, and migration behavior against the PE32 baseline.
pass_criterion: The report has a reproducible prototype and current browser-support evidence.
It recommends promotion, defer, or rejection with explicit threshold and cost.
